text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- Hungary supports Romania's plans to join NATO, meanwhile the development of economic relations between the two countries was also essential, beside the political cooperation, said PM Gyula Horn to Petre Roman, head of the Romanian senate.
- Strike is continuing at meat company at Szekszard becuase an increase in wages failed to materialise.
- Several firemen were injured when walls of a burning disco fell this morning near Nagykanizsa.
